messages: It seems #p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#, is finally ready to acknowledge my tailoring skills.
#p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat #r#o22#s#k and craft #b1 #t1002084##k to bring back to him.

#p303#, the tailor of #m10002000#, admired my craftsmanship and handed me a #t4130002#. It seems to be a special item that can alter an equipment's stats when used during crafting. Maybe I should give it a try.
name: A Tailor in My Own Right!
